name: Mangalem Quarter
tagline: Iconic Ottoman houses climbing the hillside
description: The postcard heart of Berat, where tiers of white Ottoman houses stack up the slope beneath the castle, their many windows giving the town its famous nickname. Steep cobbled lanes, mosques and cafes make it endlessly photogenic and central.
bestFor: Culture lovers wanting to live inside Berat's iconic UNESCO postcard scenery

name: Gorica Quarter
tagline: Quiet historic side across the river
description: Facing Mangalem across the Osum and reached by the old Gorica bridge, this quieter quarter offers the same tiered white houses with a calmer, more residential feel. It gives the best views back toward the famous windows and castle hill.
bestFor: Nomads seeking quiet, atmosphere and the finest views of Mangalem

name: Kala Castle Quarter
description: Berat Castle, the Kala, is a rare inhabited citadel where families still live among Byzantine churches, ruins and the Onufri icon museum. Life inside the walls is peaceful and remarkable, with panoramic views over both quarters and the valley below.
bestFor: Travellers wanting a unique stay inside a living, inhabited castle

name: Modern Centre and Bulevardi
tagline: Practical everyday town around the boulevard
description: The flat, modern heart of Berat centres on Bulevardi Republika, a lively pedestrian boulevard lined with cafes, shops, banks and restaurants. It is the most practical base for daily life, remote work and easy transport links.
bestFor: Remote workers wanting cafes, amenities and easy walkable daily convenience
pros: Best cafes and Wi-Fi for work
